blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `prepareCartToCreateStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step prepares the data used to create a cart, resolving the cart's
currency, region, customer, sales channel, and a default shipping address
when the region has a single country. It throws an error if no region is
provided.

children.name: input
children.description: The cart creation input.

children.name: region_id
children.description:
The ID of the region that the cart belongs to.
If not provided, the default region of the store is used.
If the store doesn't have a default region, an error is thrown.
